verdict.rationale: The Agent API documents Perplexity-hosted built-in tools for people and finance search, enabled by `type`, so one dedicated vertical (finance) is available as a first-party capability. The Search API's domain, language, and region filters are adjacent controls, not vertical or category filters, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: dedicated news vertical or filter, image search endpoint, finance vertical in the raw Search API (it is only an agent tool), detailed docs on finance search parameters, independent or hands-on corroboration.
